sections.briefing_title: 开发与编程日报：Datasette 图表插件钩子、SQLite 远程复制工具与 Convex skills 争议
sections.briefing_summary: 本期开发与编程版聚焦 Datasette 生态的插件更新、SQLite 的数据库远程复制工具，以及围绕 Convex skills 将用户应用创意发送至远程服务器的争议。Simon Willison 发布 datasette-charts 0.4a0，新增让其他插件定义图表类型的插件钩子，并借助 Claude Opus 5.5 构建实验插件验证该钩子；datasette-mcp 0.4 修复与 Datasette 1.0a44 的兼容性；此前的 datasette-charts 0.3a0 增加图表标注功能。基础设施方面，sqlite3_rsync 作为 SQLite 的数据库远程复制工具，于 2024 年 3.47.0 作为实验特性加入、2025 年 3.50.0 得到增强。此外，Hacker News 上一则关于 Convex skills 未经告知将用户应用创意发送至远程服务器的 GitHub issue 获得 289 分和 92 条评论。
sections.briefing_title_en: Developer Briefing: Datasette Chart Plugin Hooks, SQLite Remote Copy Tool and the Convex Skills Controversy
sections.briefing_summary_en: This developer section covers plugin updates across the Datasette ecosystem, SQLite's remote database copy tool, and a controversy over Convex skills sending user app ideas to a remote server. Simon Willison released datasette-charts 0.4a0, which adds a plugin hook letting other plugins define new chart types and was validated with an experimental plugin built using Claude Opus 5.5; datasette-mcp 0.4 fixes compatibility with Datasette 1.0a44; and the earlier datasette-charts 0.3a0 added chart annotations. On the infrastructure side, sqlite3_rsync is SQLite's remote-copy tool for databases, added as an experimental feature in 3.47.0 in 2024 and enhanced in 3.50.0 in 2025. Separately, a GitHub issue alleging that Convex skills send the user's app idea to a remote server without telling them drew 289 points and 92 comments on Hacker News.

subsections.briefing_title: 废弃PVC制油、深海灭绝风险与神经元新认识
subsections.briefing_summary: 弗吉尼亚理工大学团队发现，可在约三小时内将废弃PVC转化为高性能发动机油的原料；墨西哥湾五种深海鱼类和虾类的十余年遗传数据分析在每个受检物种中都显示灭绝风险迹象；研究识别婴儿期和开始正规学校教育两个屏幕时间可能影响较大的阶段，更多屏幕暴露与多年后学业表现较差、工作记忆较弱相关；小鼠大脑43个区域的记录显示，多数神经元会对多种输入作出反应，挑战高度专门化的长期假设。
subsections.briefing_title_en: PVC-to-Oil Process, Deep-Sea Extinction Risks and a New View of Neurons
subsections.briefing_summary_en: Virginia Tech researchers converted discarded PVC into an ingredient for high-performance engine oil in about three hours; more than a decade of genetic data showed extinction-risk signs in every one of five deep-sea fish and shrimp species examined in the Gulf; greater screen exposure in infancy and at the start of formal schooling was linked to poorer academic performance and weaker working memory years later; and recordings from 43 mouse-brain regions found most neurons respond to a wide variety of inputs, challenging the long-standing view that brain cells are highly specialized.
